gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anuphan: Plakkaat draws every letter like a bent straw, with terminals curling round to nearly touch the stem. Anuphan's big round bowls and open curves give it a sans-serif counterweight that lets the heavy heading breathe.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-arimo: Plakkaat runs one unbroken line weight through every glyph, heavy and bent like straw, with terminals curling back toward the stem. Arimo's tall, open sans text then reads smoothly and without strain.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-armata: Plakkaat arrives closed and heavy, its terminals curling nearly to the stem, against Armata's spacious, open sans-serif letters. Plakkaat earns its keep when it is set big and brief.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-athiti: Plakkaat is heavy and closed, its terminals curling toward the stem. Athiti, a sans-serif with a high mean line and see-through s shapes, keeps paragraphs light and friendly to move through.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Heavy and tightly curled, Plakkaat leans on a single bent-straw line. Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps to plain sans habits, with wide-set s terminals that make paragraphs easy to move through.

Heavy bent-straw curves with terminals nearly touching the stem: that's Plakkaat. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, plain sans with stretched-open spacing, gives that weight plenty of white space to push against.
Heavy from edge to edge, Plakkaat draws its curves and straights in a single width. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a plain sans with big open lowercase eyes, gives it an easy partner.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-biryani: Chunky, bent-straw letters curling nearly shut: that's Plakkaat. Plakkaat hits hardest in big, short bursts, while Biryani, a sans with large-eyed e shapes and unmodulated strokes, carries the plain talking.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-blinker: Plakkaat brings heavy, bent-straw letters whose terminals curl round to nearly touch the stem. And Blinker, plain sans with open apertures, gives those closed shapes a lighter, approachable neighbor.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC is a sans with clear openings at each curve and capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Plakkaat, heavy and closed, hums in a single soft line beside it.
